info.prompt: Overhead shot of a bio-mechanical game board where player territories glow like stained-glass windows in a gothic skyscraper—one cluster of three cyan-lit hexagons throbs in sync with a heartbeat monitor’s flatline beep, their connecting neon outlines flaring brighter with each pulse as the FRENZY meter hits maximum and the camera swoops low to reveal the player’s reflection in the obsidian floor: a hooded figure whose eyes burn with the same electric magenta as the active 1.5× multiplier hovering above their distorted shadow.
